description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log utility. It implements the LogNode interface, allowing it to act as a node in a chain of log handlers, forwarding log messages after processing. The class provides methods to set and get the next node, and a println method to log messages with optional exception data, supporting chaining of multiple LogNode implementations.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's Log utility for flexible logging with chaining capability.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, optional exception, and forwards the log to the next node if present.
